subject: BrightLayer trial: econ recap, target $/1M and next steps

Subject: Recap: BrightLayer discovery — econ targets & next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation today — quick recap and concrete asks so we can move toward a short trial and pricing guardrails. Notes below pulled from the call: 

- Workload profile: mostly chat completions + reranking for search intents. Expected bursty production after demo: 80M — 250M tokens/month for Q4; adoption path to ~1B tokens over 12 months if initial results hold.
- Current target unit-econ: you mentioned target $/1M tokens in the ~$900—$1,100 range; we modeled an anchor at $950/1M for committed purchase behavior.
- Budget signal: initial monthly budget window ~ $8k — $14k for pilot phase (probing latency & quality).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm BrightLayer qualifies for the startup program (company < $5M ARR, < 25 employees)? If yes, we can apply the founder credit and early-stage sweetener we discussed.
2) Confirm target $/1M you need for a 12-month commit vs a no-commit month-to-month rate (helpful for our proposals).
3) If you can share an internal budget range or PO timeline (target date to sign), we can draft a committed-use proposal and a startup-credit-backed alternative.

I've attached a short econ worksheet with three scenarios (month-to-month, 6mo small commit, and 12mo commit + multi-year option). Also attaching our standard starter SLA so you can surface questions to legal.

Attachments: brightlayer-econ-sheet.xlsx, sla-draft.pdf

Proposed internal owner: Ben Carter will own pricing conversation; Marissa will advise on whether additional founder credit is available.

Available for a 30-min follow-up Wed or Thu next week — what works for you?

Thanks,
Soojin

Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying points from our side: 

- Startup eligibility: yes — we meet the criteria (pre-revenue, small team). Would appreciate the founders/early credit you mentioned.
- Target price: for us to commit at scale (~1B tokens over 12 months) we need the effective $/1M to be no more than $900 on a committed plan.
- Short-term budget: initial pilot budget is tight — roughly $9k/month for Sept–Nov. We can stretch if the pilot shows clear quality wins but not indefinitely.

Questions: 
1) Is the $950/1M anchor you modeled the month-to-month or the committed 12mo price?
2) What sort of starter credit or refundable commitment can Redwood provide to offset the pilot risk (e.g., founder credit + applied against first invoices)?
3) Can you hold proposed pricing for 30 days while we get internal approval?

We can do Wed 10:00 PT for follow-up. I'll send a quick one-pager with the pilot scope + timeline so you and Ben can align.

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Head of Product, BrightLayer Labs

Samir — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming startup eligibility. High level options we can move quickly on (numbers are illustrative and we can lock after you share final pilot scope):

1) Startup pathway (low friction) — Starter credit + time-limited discount
   - $30k founders credit applied to first invoices (applies within first 90 days)
   - Additional 15% off list for first 3 months of usage beyond credit consumption
   - No minimum commit required; good if you want to pilot with lower risk

2) Committed 12mo (recommended if you expect growth to 1B tokens)
   - Tier A commit: 250M tokens/month -> effective rate ~$850/1M tokens (after commit discount & quantization optimizations)
   - Tier B commit: 500M tokens/month -> effective rate ~$820/1M tokens
   - Discounts structured as a blended $/1M applied monthly against usage; 12 month minimum, 60% of committed spend guaranteed.

3) Multi-year sweetener (12mo + 12mo)
   - Additional 10% off year-2 listed savings (equates to ~30% total vs month-to-month in year 2)
   - Preferable if you want price stability and slot reservation for burst capacity.

Other notes:
- We can apply the $30k credit and the startup discounts to help your Sept—Nov runway.
- If you need the $/1M at $900 exact for a 12mo commit, we can get close on Tier A with a small additional $10k commitment credit or a brief intro credit from our Growth team. Marissa, tagging you for founder-credit runway.
- I'll attach a short offer PDF and a starter SLA we can drop into a PO. If that looks good, we can route to legal for a simple MSA + SOW and aim to sign a PO by 2026-09-10 to lock pricing.

Attachments: redwood-startup-offer.pdf, sla-draft.pdf

Proposed next step: Samir, confirm which pathway you prefer (startup credit vs commit). If commit, confirm target monthly tokens and whether you'd like a 12 or 24 month structure. We'll hold the draft terms for 30 days from today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
